scope: A preparation only. Offline synthetic plans and reported-observation validation, no service scheduler or authenticated measurement. SYS03/04 integration and pilot budgets pending.

semantics.time: Signed int64 ns on a single caller-defined clock. Duration/differences must fit nonnegative signed int64. No absolute timestamp clamp. Receipt and observation times fall within start..observed_until. Arrival window end=start+duration.
semantics.arrival: Segments expand exact count/offset/spacing. Same-time order is seed-derived hash then request identity; no random scheduler simulation. Scenario labels normal/burst/overload make no performance assertion. restart/publish_delay/store_failure require respective declared fault; cold/warm require matching cache.
semantics.identity: Raw config SHA binds every artifact; common-input SHA is compact UTF8 sorted-key config excluding run_id and mode. Request ID=SHA256(domain NUL common-input-sha NUL segment-index NUL item-index); payload SHA=SHA256(domain NUL corpus-sha NUL request-id). Body-free. Different modes with same common input retain exact request IDs/times/operations/payload hashes.
semantics.ledger: External ledger required, exact full request objects including raw config SHA. Duplicate/extra/mutated request rejects. Missing ledger/result rejects by default; explicit incomplete yields missing IDs and comparison_ready=false. An absent outcome remains unknown, not fabricated pending/success.
semantics.stages: received is external ledger timestamp. accepted is applicable to every request; durable/applied/visible apply only non-read operations. Null means not observed/not claimed. Rejected cannot have accepted/stages. Later observed update stage requires earlier observed stage and monotone time. Response success does not prove async visibility.
semantics.attempts: Contiguous 1-based, at most retry_limit+1, sequential nonoverlapping. Exactly last pending may lack end; timeout end may be unknown. Last status equals logical status; completion when observed equals final attempt end. First start >= received; all times <= observed_until. No double counting retry attempts as logical requests.
semantics.latency: Completed-response distribution includes every status with observed completed_ns. Success-only distribution separate. Timeout without observed completion excluded only from numerical sample, retained in full denominator and censored count; no invented deadline latency. Nearest-rank p95/p99 index=ceil(p*N/100)-1, N explicit; empty min/mean/max/p95/p99 null. Mean exact quotient/remainder/denominator.
semantics.freshness: Reads use read_at_ns-snapshot_ns, not response duration. read_at may be known with snapshot unknown; snapshot requires read_at and cannot be future. Unknown and violation retained; no reads means quality/freshness comparison not established.
semantics.backlog: Depth and oldest age independently retain unknown. Known depth0 requires age0; known positive depth with unknown age is allowed but incomplete. Missing samples never imply empty queue.
semantics.repair: V2 retains actual nullable blocked_ns, explicit observed_from_ns/observed_through_ns within the chosen window, and republished/still_blocked/unknown end_state. Known blocked<=observed_from; validated cannot precede known blocked or follow observation bound; known republish requires validation and observed_through==republish. Future/out-of-window completed repairs reject; caller must not rewrite origin. Unknown republish never extends observed_through to global horizon. Full exact duration requires known origin and republish; ongoing origin-to-bound lower bound is separate. Exact interval/window intersection when both endpoints known is separate from witnessed window outage. Union covers witnessed intervals only; gaps/unknown start/end/fullness explicit incomplete. Legacy observations-v1 remain within-window semantics, no carry-in support and repair provenance completeness explicitly false. Empty v2 repair observations yield null observed-union, not known0; witnessed intervals may have an explicit known0 duration.
semantics.fairness: Exactly privacy and embedding coverage rows required, with nullable eligible/completed/max_wait/starvation. Unknown cannot assert no starvation. Background coverage is separate from logical request accounting.
semantics.cost: Each state/receipt/ledger/checkpoint/replay/source/log/DB/RSS dimension separate N/unknown/min/mean/max/last. Do not sum independent peaks or infer total O(1).
semantics.comparison: Explicit comparison_profile is reported_window_v1 for legacy within-window reported evidence, preserving original common-input/freshness/quality/full-denominator conditions plus fixed observed processing causality. It never means v2 carry-in/witness or B acceptance. explicit_window_witness_v2 additionally requires complete explicit repair-window witnesses, with unknown/incomplete staying false; no automatic legacy downgrade. Mixed profiles reject comparison_profile_mismatch. B execution requires explicit v2 and external actual acceptance gates, always unexecuted here. No superiority or authenticated execution inferred.
semantics.publication: Explicit absolute paths; no symlink files/ancestors, regular files, bounded reads; output exclusive create, no overwrite; single file only, no multi-file transaction implied.
semantics.processing_causality: For each observed pair: processing_started_ns<=applied_ns and processing_started_ns<=visible_ns, with applied<=visible from existing ordered stages. Missing processing with observed application/publication is unknown/incomplete, never known0; comparison readiness false. Existing stage-prefix requirements stay unchanged.

entry_gates_pending: SYS03 actual independent receiptchain acceptance and integration
SYS04 actual independent lifecycle/recovery acceptance and integration
SYS05.B bounded scheduler/atomic snapshot/fairness implementation and actual load execution
